full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting shows two young girls leaning over the stone edge of a small garden pond with a white puppy beside them. The pond fills the lower right foreground, its olive water reflecting broken patches of pale light and dark foliage. An uneven pale stone rim curves across the front, with tiny leaves and moss caught in its cracks. On the left, a blond girl crouches in a white puff-sleeved dress and deep red bodice. One hand supports her on the stone while the other rests near a low basket of warm-colored flowers at the far left. Her head tilts toward the water, and her rosy face is intent on the scene in front of her. Slightly behind and to the right, a dark-haired girl with a small pink bow bends forward in a cream pinafore over green sleeves. She looks down toward the puppy, which stands on the rim with a fluffy white body, one black ear, and its head lowered toward the water. Behind the children, a large dark planter overflows with small light blossoms. A brown-and-white cat lies along its top edge near the upper right, quietly observing the group. Foliage, rough stone, and a dark doorway crowd the background, while warm sun breaks through in patches on hair, fabric, flowers, and the pale ledge. The painterly detail is richest in faces and the puppy, becoming looser in the shadowed greenery. No readable text appears. The overall composition forms a tender diagonal from the girls through the small animal to the pond, balancing sunlit creams and reds against deep garden greens.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实油画描绘两名小女孩俯身靠在小花园池塘的石沿边，一只白色小狗陪在身旁。池塘占据右下前景，橄榄色水面映出破碎的浅亮光斑与深色枝叶。一道不平整的浅色石沿从前方弯过，裂缝里夹着细叶与苔藓。左侧，金发女孩穿着白色泡袖裙和深红色上身，蹲在岸边。一只手撑在石头上，另一只停在最左侧一篮暖色花朵附近。她低头望向水面，发红的小脸专注于眼前。稍后偏右，一位深发女孩头上有小粉色蝴蝶结，穿着奶油色围裙裙和绿色袖子，向前俯身。她低头看着小狗；小狗站在石沿上，身体蓬松洁白，一只耳朵是黑色，脑袋低向水面。孩子们身后，一只大型深色花盆里溢出小片浅色花朵。一只棕白猫躺在花盆上沿、靠近右上，安静地看着这组伙伴。枝叶、粗石和暗色门口挤满背景，暖阳以斑块方式落在头发、衣料、花朵与浅色石沿上。绘画细节在面部和小狗身上最丰富，在背阴绿叶里逐渐放松。画中没有可读文字。整体构图从女孩经小动物通向池塘形成温柔的斜线，以受光的奶油色和红色平衡深花园绿。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting uses warm natural light to draw selected pale forms out of a dense, shadowed setting. Cream, soft red, and muted gold highlights gather near the focal area, while deep green, brown, and olive masses hold the background. Controlled small strokes describe delicate expressions and tactile textures; broader, looser marks merge surrounding detail into atmosphere. Overlapping shapes establish depth, with a curved light edge in the foreground leading the eye toward the close group. Sunlight arrives in irregular patches rather than an even wash, creating a lively pattern of bright surfaces and cool recesses. Colors remain rich but natural, and softened transitions keep the mood gentle despite strong value contrast. The overall effect is sentimental and intimate, with painterly texture supporting a clear visual path.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画以暖色自然光从密集背阴环境中挑出选定的浅色形态。奶油色、柔红与低饱和金色高光聚在焦点附近，深绿、棕色与橄榄色色块稳住背景。受控的小笔触描述细微表情和可触纹理；更宽、更松的笔痕将周边细节融进氛围。相叠形体建立纵深，前景一道弯曲亮边引导视线进入紧密组合。阳光以不规则斑块而非均匀水洗落下，形成亮面与冷暗处的活跃图案。颜色浓郁却自然，柔和过渡让情绪在强明度对比中仍保持温柔。整体效果抒情而亲密，绘画肌理支撑清楚的视觉路径。
theme_en: Two girls and a white puppy beside a garden pond
theme_zh: 两名女孩与白色小狗待在花园池塘边
name: Arthur John Elsley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
